_meta.description: This file contains a serialized version of schema entities for drift.

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "clients" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "phone" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "notes" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "measurements" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "client_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES clients (id), "taken_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "measures" TEXT NOT NULL, "note" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "modeles" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "description" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "photo_path" TEXT NULL, "photo_hash" TEXT NULL, "photo_upload_state" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'none', "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (photo_upload_state IN ('none', 'pending', 'uploaded', 'failed')));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "orders" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "client_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES clients (id), "modele_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES modeles (id), "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "fabric" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "price" INTEGER NOT NULL, "delivery_date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "fitting_date" INTEGER NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'attente', "delivered_at" INTEGER NULL, "photo_path" TEXT NULL, "photo_hash" TEXT NULL, "photo_upload_state" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'none', "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (price >= 0), CHECK (photo_upload_state IN ('none', 'pending', 'uploaded', 'failed')));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "order_photos" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "order_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES orders (id), "photo_path" TEXT NOT NULL, "photo_hash" TEXT NULL, "photo_upload_state" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'none', "position" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (photo_upload_state IN ('none', 'pending', 'uploaded', 'failed')));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "client_payments" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "order_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES orders (id), "amount" INTEGER NOT NULL, "paid_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "note" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "receipt_number" INTEGER NOT NULL, "order_price_at_payment" INTEGER NOT NULL, "balance_after" INTEGER NOT NULL, "voided_at" INTEGER NULL, "void_reason" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (amount > 0), CHECK (balance_after >= 0));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "apprentices" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "phone" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "start_date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "total_fee" INTEGER NOT NULL, "next_due" INTEGER NULL, "notes" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (total_fee >= 0));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "apprentice_payments" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "apprentice_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES apprentices (id), "amount" INTEGER NOT NULL, "paid_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "note" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "receipt_number" INTEGER NOT NULL, "total_fee_at_payment" INTEGER NOT NULL, "balance_after" INTEGER NOT NULL, "voided_at" INTEGER NULL, "void_reason" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (amount > 0), CHECK (balance_after >= 0));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "realisations" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "category" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Autre', "client_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES clients (id), "caption" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "photo_path" TEXT NOT NULL, "photo_hash" TEXT NULL, "photo_upload_state" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'none', "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (photo_upload_state IN ('none', 'pending', 'uploaded', 'failed')));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "settings" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "receipt_counters" ("counter_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "last_value" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("counter_name"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_outbox" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "op" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "attempts" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "last_error" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (op IN ('upsert', 'delete')));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_state" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("key"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "notification_log" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "channel" TEXT NOT NULL, "category" TEXT NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "body" TEXT NOT NULL, "item_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "alert_keys" TEXT NOT NULL, "scheduled_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "fired_at" INTEGER NULL, "ended_at" INTEGER NULL, "outcome" TEXT NOT NULL, "snooze_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "seen_at" INTEGER NULL, "source_event_id" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_client_payments_receipt_number ON client_payments (receipt_number)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_apprentice_payments_receipt_number ON apprentice_payments (receipt_number)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_settings_key ON settings ("key")
CREATE INDEX idx_sync_outbox_entity_row ON sync_outbox (entity, entity_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_notification_log_source_event_id ON notification_log (source_event_id)
